item.title: DeSantis backs Florida GOP ticket, including Byron Donalds for governor
item.description: Florida Governor Ron DeSantis endorsed a group of Republican candidates, which includes gubernatorial hopeful Byron Donalds.

item.title: Democratic establishment prevails as insurgents lose and GOP weakens in blue state
item.description: Massachusetts Democrats chose Ed Markey, 80, over Seth Moulton after Moulton called for generational change.

item.title: Comer tells Newsmax: Ending birth tourism is a key priority
item.description: Rep. James Comer, R-Ky., stated to Newsmax that ending birth tourism is a major focus for House Republicans.

item.title: Texas Democrat candidate plans Hollywood fundraiser as GOP gathers in Dallas
item.description: James Talarico is set for another celebrity fundraiser in Hollywood while Ken Paxton and Trump rally Republicans in Dallas.
